subject: Urgent: Proposal for Performance Credits and Next Steps
messages:
From: Elena Stevens <elena.stevens@clearledger.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@clearledger.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 10:04:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Production degradation impacting ClearLedger — urgent

Hi Neha / Rishi,

We started seeing a sustained degradation in our ClearLedger production traffic starting late on Mar 10 and continuing through yesterday. Symptoms: 3–4x increase in 95th/99th latency for token generation, intermittent 5xx error spikes (peaked at ~7% of requests for a 90-minute window on Mar 11), and overall throughput falling ~40% during the event window. Our payments reconciliation jobs stalled and our ops team had to failover to a cached path which affected reconciliation fidelity.

This is a material service disruption against the contract SLA (Section 4.2). We need: 1) a prompt remediation plan and timeline; 2) a calculation for SLA credits for the impacted window; and 3) executive confirmation that remediation and follow-up postmortem will be prioritized.

I've attached a short summary (clearledger_error_summary_Mar10-11.pdf) with sample trace IDs and a chart of the error spike. We need written confirmation of next steps and an estimate of the credit you plan to apply.

Elena
Director of Engineering
ClearLedger Inc.

Attachments: clearledger_error_summary_Mar10-11.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Stevens <elena.stevens@clearledger.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 11:15:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Production degradation impacting ClearLedger — urgent

Elena — thank you for the summary and the trace samples. I'm very sorry for the disruption.

Short answers up front: we will own the investigation, propose a credit calculation within 48 hours, and schedule an executive call today to review impact and timelines.

I've looped in Rishi (sales) and Sean (CS) so we can coordinate the credit estimate and immediate mitigations. Can you confirm a 3pm PT / 6pm ET time window for a 30-minute call today? Also: if you can share two example request IDs and the associated timestamps (in UTC), that will speed root-cause work.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 13:03:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Production degradation impacting ClearLedger — urgent

Thanks — drafting initial credit calc for the call. Quick notes for context: per contract Section 4.2 "Availability and Remedies," sustained error rate above 1% for >60m qualifies for credits. Based on the timeline in Elena's doc, the primary impacted window is ~2026-03-10 22:30 UTC through 2026-03-11 02:00 UTC. Rough back-of-envelope: invoice for Mar period is $112,500; impacted window is ~3.5 hours against a 30-day month -> proposed starting credit range 4–6% (we can justify on a pro-rata availability basis), plus a one-time goodwill credit for ops impact (suggest $7,500). I'll upload a spreadsheet with exact math: credit_calc_sheet.xlsx.

Important: legal needs to approve the wording. Recommend we offer a formal credit + a joint postmortem and an SLA amendment for response SLAs to add clarity. Also recommend we have Marissa (SVP Product) on the exec call to commit to timeline.

Rishi
Account Exec
Redwood Inference

Attachments: credit_calc_sheet.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production degradation impacting ClearLedger — internal

Internal notes (do not forward to customer yet):

- Product: short-term mitigation options include pinned instance for the ClearLedger model variant, temporary queue-throttling bypass for critical paths, and emergency cache warmers. Engineering estimates ~48–72 hours to stabilize the KV cache hotpath.
- Finance/Legal: credits lookup and contract language. Vanessa, please confirm whether the contract allows the one-time goodwill credit without further approvals.
- Execs: I'll join the external call and provide the product commit. We need a clear postmortem schedule (prelim within 72h, final within 10 business days).

Please confirm owners: Sean — lead communications and runbook for ClearLedger ops; Rishi — credit proposal; Vanessa — legal/finance clearance; Neha — customer exec contact and external call.

Marissa
SVP Product
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Stevens <elena.stevens@clearledger.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@clearledger.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 15:30:47 -0700
Subject: Proposed credit and remediation plan — ClearLedger production event (Mar 10–11)

Elena / Raj — thanks again for your patience while we investigated. Below is our formal proposal:

1) Credit: a service credit equivalent to 5% of ClearLedger's March 2026 invoice ($5,625) applied to the next billing cycle, plus a one-time operational goodwill credit of $7,500 to offset reconciliation costs. Total credit: $13,125. (See attached proposed_credit_agreement.pdf for wording.)

2) Remediation timeline: product will prioritize fixes on the KV cache hotpath; expected stabilization within 48–72 hours from Mar 13 when fixes were deployed. We'll provide daily status updates until the postmortem is published.

3) Governance & follow-up: Marissa Cole (SVP Product) will present the postmortem in an executive call and commit to a documented SLA amendment that clarifies response and mitigation timelines for future incidents. We propose a 30-minute executive call on Tue, Mar 16 at 10am PT to finalize wording and sign the agreement.

4) Next steps: if the credit terms above are acceptable we'll issue a DocuSign for the credit agreement and postmortem/SL A amendment language.

Attachments: proposed_credit_agreement.pdf, error_logs_q1.csv, txn_latency_chart.png

Neha Kapoor
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

--
